digo: Chibugu; Chibugu chichetu (female form, Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: Its name simply means 'little climber', and Digo think of it as the female half of a pair.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana tu ya 'mtambaa mdogo', na Wadigo humwona kama nusu ya kike ya jozi.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'mbugu dide' tu, na Adigo anachiona dza nusu ya chichetu ya jozi.

summary.en: *Chibugu* is a small twining legume with soft, velvety leaves divided in three. The name means 'little climber', and Pakia notes that Digo see it as the female partner of *chibugu chilume*.
summary.sw: *Chibugu* ni mtambaa mdogo unaojizungusha wa jamii ya kunde, wenye majani laini kama mahameli yaliyogawanyika mara tatu. Jina lake lina maana ya 'mtambaa mdogo', na Pakia inaeleza kuwa Wadigo humwona kama mwenzi wa kike wa *chibugu chilume*.
summary.dg: *Chibugu* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde unaolinga-linga, wenye makodza laini dza nguwo ya *velvet*, ganayogbwanyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu. Dzina rina mana ya 'mbugu dide', na Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anachiona dza mchetu wa *chibugu chilume*.

about.en: *Rhynchosia velutina* is a twining herb of the pea family. It has leaves divided into three broad leaflets, velvety with soft hairs, small yellow pea flowers and short, flat pods. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Rhynchosia velutina* ni mmea unaojizungusha wa jamii ya kunde. Una majani yaliyogawanyika katika vijani vitatu vipana, laini kama mahameli kwa vinyweleo laini, maua madogo ya manjano ya jamii ya kunde, na maganda mafupi bapa. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Rhynchosia velutina* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde unaolinga-linga. Makodzage ganagbwanyika kuhenda makodza madide mahahu mapana, genye nyere ndide laini dza *velvet*. Una maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano, dza ga kunde, na makakaya mafupi ga kubapa. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It twines over grass and shrubs in bushland and grassland.
where.sw: Hujizungusha juu ya nyasi na vichaka vichakani na mbugani.
where.dg: Unalinga-linga dzulu ya nyasi na vitsaka, weruni na phatu pha nyasi.

culture.en: *Chibugu* is the small form of *mbugu*, 'climber', and Digo use the stem *-bugu* across many climbing plants. Pakia records this species as the female form, *chibugu chichetu* ('female climber'). Because it is the female, it also takes the plain name *chibugu*. *Indigofera trita* is called *chibugu chilume*, 'male climber', though nobody could explain to Pakia why that one counts as the male.
culture.sw: *Chibugu* ni umbo dogo la *mbugu*, 'mtambaa', na Wadigo hutumia shina la neno *-bugu* kwa mimea mingi inayotambaa. Pakia inarekodi spishi hii kama umbo la kike, *chibugu chichetu* ('mtambaa wa kike'). Kwa sababu ni wa kike, pia huchukua jina la kawaida *chibugu*. *Indigofera trita* huitwa *chibugu chilume*, 'mtambaa wa kiume', ingawa hakuna aliyeweza kumweleza Pakia kwa nini huo ndio huhesabiwa wa kiume.
culture.dg: *Chibugu* ni dzina ra udide ra *mbugu*, 'mmea unaokpwera', na Adigo anahumira shina *-bugu* kpwa mimea minji inayokpwera. Pakia anaandika aina hino kukala ni ya chichetu, *chibugu chichetu* ('mbugu ya chichetu'). Kpwa sababu ni ya chichetu, piya inahala dzina bahi *chibugu*. *Indigofera trita* inaihwa *chibugu chilume*, 'mbugu ya chilume', ela takuna mutu ariyeweza kumuelezera Pakia kpwa nini hiyo ndiyo ya chilume.

names.en: Pakia records both *chibugu* and *chibugu chichetu* for this species. The climber stem also turns up in *mbugubugu* (*Cissus*), *libugu pamba* and *mkone chibugu*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi *chibugu* na *chibugu chichetu* kwa spishi hii. Shina hili la 'mtambaa' linajitokeza pia katika *mbugubugu* (*Cissus*), *libugu pamba* na *mkone chibugu*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chibugu* na *chibugu chichetu* kpwa aina hino. Shina ra 'mbugu' piya rinaphahikana kpwenye *mbugubugu* (*Cissus*), *libugu pamba* na *mkone chibugu*.

reason.en: Another plant named as a climber
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine uliopewa jina la mtambaa
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina uriohewa dzina ra mbugu
